water.note: Shallow/deep tint and caustics are presentation settings for whoever writes the water shader; the GLB ships a flat lit plane. Ssarathi's water is shallow over most of its area, so the shallow tint is what will actually be seen.

presentation.note: Declared, not implemented: no particle systems ship in the GLB.
